quiz.title: Industrial Revolution Quiz
quiz.description: Test your knowledge of the Industrial Revolution.

questions.questionText: Where did the Industrial Revolution begin?
questions.explanation: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the late eighteenth century.

questions.questionText: Which invention greatly improved steam engine efficiency?
questions.explanation: James Watt's improvements in the 1760s and 1770s made steam power practical for factories.

wrongExplanations.q2-b: The spinning jenny was a textile invention, not a steam engine improvement.

questions.questionText: Which industry was among the first to industrialize?
questions.explanation: Textile manufacturing adopted mechanized spinning and weaving early in the Industrial Revolution.

wrongExplanations.q3-b: Banking expanded with industrial growth but was not among the first mechanized industries.

questions.questionText: What process made steel cheaper and stronger in the nineteenth century?
questions.explanation: The Bessemer process revolutionized steel production in the nineteenth century.

wrongExplanations.q4-b: The water frame was a textile machine, not a steel-making process.

questions.questionText: Which technology revolutionized long-distance communication in the nineteenth century?
questions.explanation: The telegraph allowed messages to travel across continents in hours rather than weeks.

wrongExplanations.q5-b: The power loom automated weaving but did not transmit messages.

quiz.sourceContent: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the late eighteenth century.
